**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement has no auto-renewal trap. The licence is perpetual subject to fee payment (§ 17(a)), Sparkling can terminate on 90 days' notice (§ 17(b)), and maintenance is a "renewable one-year term" (§ 10) — a 12-month term renewing only by agreement, with no evergreen roll-over, no non-renewal notice window, and no multi-year renewal. This sits at the preferred position.

One sub-element noted in the rationale rather than flagged: there is no CPI/3% cap on renewal-year maintenance fees, which are simply left to the Fee Schedule. Worth confirming the Fee Schedule fixes or caps renewal pricing, but since renewal requires our agreement we retain the leverage.
